question: Which specific epithets of the deity are affirmed as recipients of ritual obeisance?
premises: Obeisance is offered to one clad in cowhide.
Obeisance is offered to the golden-armed one.
inference: The deity is honored through multiple distinct epithets, each receiving formal obeisance.
uncertainties: Whether haraye refers specifically to Viṣṇu or functions as a broader epithet in this context.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one clad in cowhide, obeisance to Hari, obeisance to the golden-armed one.
